intro.heading: Elite Autohaus
intro.body:
Established in 2014, Elite Autohaus has been providing quality Pre-Owned Vehicles for over 12 years in GTA and surrounding area. We have helped thousands of customers buy, sell and trade their vehicles.

Elite Autohaus was built on a foundation of TRANSPARENCY and HONEST CAR SALES.

Owners have over 35 years of combined experience in Pre-owned Luxury and Performance Vehicles.

Our many years in business have helped us better understand the needs of our clients and provide them with a quality, luxury vehicle for a fraction of the new sticker price.

We personally hand select each vehicle requested by our clients to ensure that they meet our strict quality standards. We look forward to putting you in the driver's seat of your next dream car.

cta1.heading: Looking to Buy a Car?
cta1.body:
Let us know what you are looking for and we will search nationwide through our established network of dealer and auction partners.

We handle all the details, negotiate the price on your behalf and deliver the vehicle to your door!

cta2.heading: Looking to Sell Your Car?
cta2.body:
We make selling your car a quick and hassle free experience!

We will take care of all the paperwork and cut you a cheque the moment you drop off your car!

yachts.name: 1998 Sea Ray 400 Sundancer
yachts.description: This stunning 1998 Sea Ray 400 Sundancer is one of the finest express cruisers on the market. Powered by twin MerCruiser 7.4L engines, she cruises effortlessly at 28 knots. The spacious interior features a full galley, master stateroom, and a second sleeping area. Recently serviced with new upholstery throughout. Perfect for extended cruising on Lake Ontario and beyond.

yachts.name: 2000 Sea Ray 380
yachts.description: A beautifully maintained 2000 Sea Ray 380 Sundancer. This vessel features twin 350 MPI engines, a full walk-around deck, and a luxurious interior with all the amenities needed for comfortable cruising. New canvas, detailed and ready to go.

yachts.name: 1995 Sea Ray 400 Express
yachts.description: Classic 1995 Sea Ray 400 Express Cruiser in excellent condition. Twin engine power plant delivers strong performance. Spacious cockpit perfect for entertaining. Full cabin below with all amenities. Well maintained with service records available.

yachts.name: 2000 Advantage PokerRun 40
yachts.description: An absolute head-turner. This 2000 Advantage PokerRun 40 is built for performance and style. Twin high-output engines deliver exhilarating speed. Low hours, garage stored, and in exceptional condition. One of a kind opportunity.

yachts.name: 2005 Sea Ray 290 SLX
yachts.description: The 2005 Sea Ray 290 SLX is a versatile and stylish deck boat perfect for families and entertaining. Single engine, easy to handle, with a large open cockpit and wet bar. Fresh canvas, new seats, and full service completed.

yachts.name: 2006 Rinker 300 Fiesta Vee
yachts.description: The 2006 Rinker 300 Fiesta Vee offers comfortable cruising with a deep-V hull for smooth offshore performance. Features a full cabin, generator, air conditioning, and a large aft cockpit. Turnkey and ready to enjoy this season.

yachts.name: 2016 Yamaha AR192
yachts.description: Fun and sporty 2016 Yamaha AR192 sport boat. Powered by a Yamaha 1.8L high-output marine engine delivering 110hp. Perfect for watersports, day trips and lake cruising. Low hours and in excellent condition.

yachts.name: 2021 Lund Angler 1650ss
yachts.description: Brand new condition 2021 Lund Angler 1650ss fishing boat. Rigged for serious anglers with rod holders, livewells, and a Minn Kota trolling motor. Includes a trailer. Perfect for lakes and rivers across Ontario.

yachts.name: 2001 Doral 360SE
yachts.description: Impressive 2001 Doral 360SE with twin engines and all the space you need for extended cruising. Features a full-beam master stateroom, large galley, and spacious salon. Beautifully maintained and a rare find at this price point.

yachts.name: 1989 Carver 3806
yachts.description: Details coming soon. Contact us to be the first to know when this vessel is listed.

yachts.name: 2000 Sea Ray 540 Sundancer
yachts.description: Sea Ray’s reputation for quality innovative design is on full display with this 540 Sundancer. The sleek, modern lines of the hull are complemented by two spacious cabins, and offers a commanding view of the water and perfect for entertaining. Powerful Twin Diesel Engines: Powered by twin 3196 Caterpillar diesel engines, this yacht provides smooth cruising at an efficient pace. Whether you're exploring coastal waters or heading to distant destinations, the performance is second to none.
